entities.summary: Neal Skupski is a British professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. He has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 1. He first achieved this milestone in November 2022, topping the rankings jointly with long-time partner Wesley Koolhof at the end of that year. Skupski became the third British world no. 1 in doubles after Jamie Murray and Joe Salisbury.
